# DRL-033: Publish an allowlisted public replay artifact mirror

> **CLOSED 2026-08-22 as superseded by RES-024.** The mirror was built,
> verified end to end, and never deployed. The Director elected to publish the
> authoritative repository itself, which removes the constraint the mirror
> existed to work around — GitHub Pages will not serve a private personal
> repository on the current plan.
>
> Retired with it: `configs/public-artifact-export.yaml`,
> `configs/open-exceptions/DRL-OEX-0001.json`,
> `scripts/prepare_public_replay_release.py`,
> `.github/workflows/publish-replays.yml`, and
> `tests/test_public_artifact_export.py`. `scripts/build_replay_site.py`
> survives; a public repository can serve its output from its own Pages.
>
> `ADR-0009` is `SUPERSEDED` and `DRL-OSS-022` is rewritten for direct
> publication. The original body is kept below unedited as the record of what
> was specified and why. Nothing below is current practice.

## User / research value

Give faculty, admissions readers, mentors, and research peers a real success and
degraded recorded run to inspect while the authoritative research repository
remains private through September 2026.

## Problem

The replay build succeeds in the private authoritative repository, but GitHub
Pages cannot deploy from that repository on the Director's current plan. Making
the repository public early violates RES-018. Copying arbitrary files to a
public repository would create an unsafe, unauditable disclosure boundary.

## Scope

### In scope

- Create the approved public deployment mirror
  `chris-dewitt/dewitt-research-artifacts`.
- Export only the generated success/degraded replay pages and required release
  metadata admitted by policy.
- Build on relevant pushes; publish only after manual dispatch.
- Record source revision, hashes, licenses, maturity, limitations, contact, and
  the temporary open exception.
- Configure GitHub Pages from the public repository's `main` branch.
- Verify the public URL and read back deployed artifact hashes.

### Out of scope

- Making `DeWitt-Research-Lab` public before 2026-09-30.
- Publishing source code, working papers, uncontrolled documents, private
  traces, employer information, or credentials.
- Publishing a research paper before its individual release and rights gates.
- Creating GCP, Cloudflare, Vercel, or other hosting resources.
- Configuring a custom domain or changing Wix DNS.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Public repository exists with generated files only.
- [ ] Unexpected files, symlinks, credential patterns, and local paths fail the export.
- [ ] Ordinary pushes create review artifacts but cannot publish.
- [ ] Manual publication uses a fine-grained token scoped only to the target repository.
- [ ] Release manifest records source SHA, per-file SHA-256, maturity, licenses, limitations, contact, and DRL-OEX-0001.
- [ ] Public Pages URL renders success and degraded runs with explicit replay labels.
- [ ] Public read-back matches the reviewed release manifest.
- [ ] Required validators, tests, secret scan, and `git diff --check` pass.

## Verification plan

```bash
uv run pytest -q tests/test_public_artifact_export.py tests/test_replay_site.py tests/evalforge/test_signed_replays.py
uv run python scripts/validate_program.py
uv run python scripts/validate_foundation.py
uv run python scripts/validate_open_identity.py
uv run python scripts/build_replay_site.py --out site/replays --metadata
uv run python scripts/prepare_public_replay_release.py --site-dir site/replays --out site/public-replays --source-revision <full-sha>
```

Validate workflow YAML, scan the exact export for secrets and local paths, and
compare public bytes to `release-manifest.json` after deployment.

## Security / privacy / licensing / cost

The private/public boundary is deny-by-default. Cross-repository credentials
never enter source or output. The public mirror is temporarily labeled
`public_only`; Apache-2.0 applies to renderer software and CC-BY-4.0 to rendered
content. GitHub Pages hosting cost is $0. The demo HMAC is disclosed as a fixture
integrity mechanism rather than production provenance.

## Rollback

Disable the workflow, revoke `PUBLIC_ARTIFACT_TOKEN`, unpublish Pages, and remove
the Wix link. Preserve the private source and historical release evidence.

## Evidence required for closure

Branch and commit, exact commands and results, generated release manifest,
workflow run and artifact IDs, public repository and Pages URL, public hash
read-back, security scan, open-exception record, and final handoff.
